The '''Isle of Souls Dungeon''' is a small dungeon located on the eastern side of the [[Isle of Souls]]. It houses several types of monsters, all of which can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]]. The dungeon also contains a [[Chest (Isle of Souls Dungeon)|chest]] which can be thieved for several resources such as [[gem]]s and [[grimy herb]]s, as well as a rare chance for a [[dark key]].

A [[dwarf multicannon]] can be used in the dungeon, though it is not a [[multicombat area]].
{{Map|2309,2919|mtype=square|align=left|caption=The entrance to the dungeon.|r=4|width=250|height=250}}

==Transportation==
The dungeon can be reached by teleporting to [[fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|BJP}} on the northern coast of the isle, then running south-east.

Otherwise, players can use a [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Soul Wars]] and run north-east. A dose of [[stamina potion]] drunk at the bank in the Soul Wars lobby will expire on reaching the deepest part of the dungeon.

==Monsters==
[[File:Blue dragon (Isle of Souls Dungeon) safespot.png|thumb|The safespot for blue dragons.]]
The dungeon features four main rooms, each containing a specific type of slayer monster. Several [[skeleton]]s also wander throughout the dungeon. In anti-clockwise order from the entrance, the four rooms contain:
#Four [[lesser demon|lesser]] and seven [[greater demon]]s.
#Eight [[fire giant]]s.
#Four [[blue dragon]]s and three [[baby blue dragon]]s. Six [[blue dragon scale]]s also spawn.
#Three [[iron dragon]]s.

It is highly recommended to bring some kind of [[Dragonfire#Protection|anti-fire protection]] when venturing deeper into this dungeon, due to the number of dragons that can be found around the useful resources.

The blue dragons can be [[safespot]]ted by standing in the cove next to the [[adamantite rocks]], but the iron dragons cannot be due to their long-range [[dragonfire]] attack.

The dungeon features three rocks that can be mined for ore: two [[adamantite rocks]] near the blue dragons, and a single [[runite rock]] near the iron dragons. Players may be attacked by an iron dragon while trying to mine [[runite ore]] if they draw its [[aggression]] while walking through the room.

===Chest===
In the hallway between the two dragon rooms is a locked [[Chest (Isle of Souls Dungeon)|chest]] which can be opened with level 28 [[Thieving]]. It rarely drops [[medium clue]]s as well as [[dark key]]s, which are used to unlock the [[Dark Chest]] in the [[Crumbling Tower]] basement. It also commonly drops [[uncut gem]]s and [[grimy herb]]s, so bringing a [[gem bag]] and [[herb sack]] is highly recommended when stealing from this chest, as there is no nearby [[bank]].

Having a [[lockpick]] in the inventory increases the chance to pick open the chest by about 10%. Failure to pick the chest carries a 1/6 chance to be teleported outside of the entrance to the dungeon.
